en: The image shows the written/address side of an old postcard. Along the top are multilingual words for "postcard" in French, Hungarian, Italian, Czech/Slovak, German and Dutch. Below is handwritten text in cursive Russian, addressed to a recipient. There is a red Imperial Russian postage stamp in the upper right corner with a double‑headed eagle coat of arms and two postal cancellation marks in Cyrillic, one dated with the year 1913 (19 13/III). The card is aged and slightly worn at the edges.
